cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.5-9B: capabilities codegym
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 2. General capabilities after agentic training on CodeGym. Qwen3.5-9B. Both GRPO and Dyad-GRPO are compared with the same original model for Knowledge (MMLU-Pro), Mathematical Reasoning (HMMT February 2026), and Coding (LiveCodeBench v6). Values are absolute score changes (%).
